name: no-campaign-ran
about: A day with no campaign spending: no campaign rows, the month's spend so far, and the cohorts.

output.headline: No campaigns ran on 2026-11-03, so there was no spend, no impressions, no clicks, and no leads for the day.
points: The day totals show $0.00 spent, 0 impressions, 0 clicks, and no leads, meaning there is also no cost per lead or click rate to report.
For the month of 2026-11, with 28 days left, the only spend recorded so far is $400.00 on Meta — nothing on any other platform.
The cohort from the week of 2026-09-21 brought in 38 leads: 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 qualified (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost (21.1%).
The cohort from the week of 2026-09-28 brought in 40 leads: 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 qualified (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost (22.5%).
The cohort from the week of 2026-10-26 has 12 leads so far — 9 contacted, 3 qualified, 1 applied, and 1 lost — but it is too young to judge rates yet.
